Interviewer: This intake is for the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: I want to change an existing parenting arrangement, not start a divorce.
Caller: My name is Tessa Flint.
Caller: I live at 21 Example Row, Alderhaven.
Interviewer: Who is the other parent?
Caller: Oren Flint. Our child is Tavi Flint born 2014-04-09.
Caller: The existing order is dated 2021-06-11.
Caller: My request is this: Move the weekly visit from Tuesday to Thursday.
